Job description

Australia Network Services Pty Ltd (ANS) is seeking a suitably qualified and experienced Software Engineer for our client operating in the software development, IT services, and digital solutions industry in Sydney, Australia.

On a full-time basis, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, maintaining, and improving software applications and systems. You will work closely with internal teams, business stakeholders, and technical staff to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-focused software solutions.


Job Title: Software Engineer, Full-Time Position
ANZSCO Code: 261313 Software Engineer
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours: 38 hours per week
Work Location: In person
Industry: Software Development / IT Services / Digital Solutions


Key Responsibilities
The successful candidate will contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, system design, frontend and backend development, database integration, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing system maintenance.

Main Duties and Tasks
- Analyse business and technical requirements and translate them into software solutions.
- Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications, platforms, and system features.
- Develop frontend interfaces using technologies such as JavaScript, React, Vue.js, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and application logic using suitable programming languages and frameworks.
- Design, manage, and optimise databases using SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar database systems.
- Develop RESTful APIs and support integration between internal systems and third-party platforms.
- Write clean, efficient, reusable, and maintainable code in accordance with development standards.
- Conduct debugging, troubleshooting, code reviews, and performance optimisation.
- Participate in system design, software architecture planning, and technical documentation.
- Support cloud-based deployment, version control, CI/CD, and DevOps activities using tools such as AWS, Azure, Git, Jenkins, or similar.
- Work with product managers, designers, business users, and technical teams to deliver software that meets business objectives.
- Prepare user guides, technical documentation, release notes, and system support materials.
- Maintain data security, system reliability, and compliance with workplace policies and procedures.
- Support ongoing system upgrades, enhancements, and legacy system improvements.

Essential Requirements
- Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience as a Software Engineer, Software Developer, Full-Stack Developer, or in a similar software development role.
- Experience in frontend development using JavaScript, React, Vue.js, HTML5, CSS3, or similar technologies.
- Experience with backend development, APIs, databases, and system integration.
- Knowledge of programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, Java, or similar.
- Experience with SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or other relational database systems.
- Understanding of software development lifecycle, system design, testing, debugging, and deployment processes.
- Experience using Git, cloud platforms, CI/CD tools, or DevOps practices is highly regarded.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and technical troubleshooting skills.
- Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality software solutions.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced technical environment.


If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to-date CV. We can schedule a time to discuss the position and assess your suitability for the role.

About position
The SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Consultant is responsible for analysing business requirements, and designing, configuring and implementing SAP EAM solutions that optimise asset management and maintenance processes for clients operating in asset-intensive industries. The role partners with business stakeholders to maximise asset reliability, reduce maintenance costs and support digital transformation through effective SAP EAM solutions, while ensuring project delivery meets quality standards, timelines and client requirements.

Responsibilities
- Consult with clients, users and stakeholders to understand organisational objectives, operational requirements and asset management needs.
- Identify, investigate and analyse business processes, procedures and work practices to determine inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
- Define, document and validate functional requirements for SAP solutions supporting asset management and maintenance operations, and recommend process improvements and system enhancements.
- Design, configure and implement SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) solutions aligned with operational requirements and industry best practice, including asset structures, functional locations, equipment records, maintenance notifications, work orders, preventive and corrective maintenance processes, maintenance plans and maintenance strategies.
- Develop functional specifications, data and process models, system documentation and process maps to support SAP solution design, configuration and development.
- Collaborate with technical consultants, developers and project teams to deliver integrated SAP solutions that meet business requirements and technical standards.
- Apply project management methodologies, principles and techniques to develop project plans, estimate costs, allocate resources and manage SAP EAM implementation activities to achieve project milestones and deadlines.
- Develop and execute test plans, including unit, integration and user acceptance testing (UAT), and coordinate data migration, master data validation, system deployment and go-live activities.
- Prepare user documentation, business process documentation and training materials, and deliver formal training to end users.
- Provide post-implementation support, troubleshoot functional issues and monitor SAP EAM processes and performance to identify improvements.
- Act as a central functional reference point throughout project delivery, liaising with clients, users, project managers, developers and cross-functional teams to ensure solutions meet requirements, quality standards and project objectives.

Skills and Qualifications required to perform the above job role
- Tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems or a related discipline. 
- SAP certification or relevant SAP EAM/PM training is highly regarded.
- Minimum of 5 years' experience implementing and supporting SAP Enterprise Asset Management (SAP EAM/PM) solutions.
- Strong business analysis skills, with the ability to identify business requirements, analyse processes and develop functional specifications, process models, documentation and test plans.
- Experience in project management, with strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills, and the ability to oversee the implementation of complex IT projects.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with technical teams, business stakeholders and end users.

## ICT Support Technician
## Position Overview
We are looking for a motivated and technically proficient ICT Support Technician to join our team and provide reliable support across our computer infrastructure, software systems, and web technologies. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving technical issues, maintaining hardware and software environments, and ensuring end users receive timely and effective assistance. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with strong communication skills and a genuine passion for technology. This position suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is committed to delivering high-quality technical support.
## Key Responsibilities
- Assess software and hardware requirements to identify appropriate technical solutions and resolve user-reported problems effectively.
- Respond promptly to enquiries from staff regarding software and hardware issues, providing clear guidance and practical resolutions in a professional manner.
- Install, configure, and maintain approved software applications, ensuring systems remain up to date, secure, and aligned with organisational standards.
- Adapt and modify existing programs and system configurations to better meet the evolving needs of end users and business operations.
- Implement, configure, and monitor computer networks, supporting both wired and wireless infrastructure to maintain consistent connectivity across the organisation.
- Design, update, and maintain organisational websites, ensuring content accuracy, functionality, and a positive user experience.
- Repair and replace peripheral equipment such as printers, terminals, monitors, and modems, maintaining accurate records of assets and service activity.
- Provide first- and second-level technical support to end users, either in person, remotely, or via a helpdesk or call centre environment, logging all incidents and resolutions through the appropriate ticketing system.
- Promote the efficient and effective use of applications and equipment across teams, offering training and guidance where required.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to escalate and resolve complex technical issues in a timely manner.
- Conduct routine system checks, preventative maintenance, and performance monitoring to minimise downtime and ensure infrastructure reliability.
- Maintain thorough technical documentation, including user guides, network diagrams, and records of system configurations and changes.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Certificate III or IV in Information Technology, or a relevant tertiary qualification in ICT, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience in a technical support, helpdesk, or IT operations role.
- Solid understanding of computer hardware components, operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux), and common business software applications.
- Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting software and peripheral devices.
- Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and LAN/WAN connectivity.
- Familiarity with web technologies and basic website maintenance, including content management systems.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose technical issues efficiently and accurately.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and maintain composure under pressure.
- A customer-focused approach with a professional and courteous manner in all interactions.
## Preferred Qualifications
- CompTIA A+, Network+, or equivalent industry certification.
- ITIL Foundation certification or familiarity with ITIL service management principles.
- Experience working in a managed service provider (MSP) or enterprise IT environment.
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft 365, Azure, or Google Workspace.
- Experience with remote desktop tools and helpdesk ticketing systems such as ServiceNow, Freshdesk, or Jira Service Management.
- Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and endpoint protection solutions.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and supportive team culture that values continuous learning and professional growth.
- Access ongoing training, certification support, and clear pathways for career advancement within the ICT field.
- Enjoy a stable, full-time permanent role with a competitive salary and superannuation package.
- Benefit from flexible working arrangements and a healthy work-life balance in a forward-thinking organisation.
- Work with modern technology and contribute to meaningful projects that directly support business operations and user experience.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

## Technical Writer

## Position Overview

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Writer to join our team and produce clear, accurate, and user-friendly documentation that supports both internal operations and end-user understanding. This role is central to bridging the gap between complex technical concepts and accessible written content across a range of formats and platforms. The ideal candidate will bring strong research capabilities, excellent written communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with subject matter experts, developers, and stakeholders. A background in a technical discipline combined with a passion for clear communication would make you an exceptional fit for this position.

## Key Responsibilities

- Research, develop, and maintain a broad range of technical documentation including user manuals, handbooks, training materials, standard operating procedures, and multimedia content

- Translate complex technical information into clear, concise, and accurate content tailored to the intended audience, whether end users, internal teams, or stakeholders

- Collaborate closely with engineers, developers, product managers, and subject matter experts to gather information and verify technical accuracy across all documentation

- Plan, organise, and manage documentation projects from initial brief through to final publication, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met

- Review and edit existing documentation to identify gaps, inconsistencies, or outdated content, and update materials to reflect product or process changes

- Develop and apply style guides, templates, and documentation standards to ensure consistency in tone, format, and terminology across all written outputs

- Produce content for digital and print formats including online help systems, knowledge bases, e-learning modules, and technical reference guides

- Liaise with stakeholders to understand documentation requirements and translate business or technical briefs into structured, reader-focused content

- Conduct quality assurance reviews of documentation prior to release, checking for technical accuracy, readability, grammar, and adherence to brand and style guidelines

- Support the development of training materials and contribute to onboarding programmes by producing clear instructional content for new users or staff

- Manage version control and document repositories, ensuring all materials are correctly filed, versioned, and accessible to relevant teams

## Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Technical Writing, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline

- Demonstrated experience in a technical writing role, ideally within a corporate, technology, or engineering environment

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy

- Proven ability to research, interpret, and document complex technical subjects in a clear and accessible manner

- Proficiency in documentation tools such as MadCap Flare, Confluence, Microsoft Word, or equivalent platforms

- Experience working with content management systems, version control tools, and document repositories

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines

- Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and build effective relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Sound understanding of documentation best practices, including the use of style guides such as the Microsoft Manual of Style or equivalent

## Preferred Qualifications

- Postgraduate qualification or professional certification in Technical Communication, such as a Certificate IV in Professional Writing and Editing or equivalent

- Experience with API documentation, software development lifecycle (SDLC), or working within Agile project environments

- Familiarity with graphic design or multimedia tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Snagit, or Camtasia to support visual documentation

- Exposure to single-sourcing methodologies and structured authoring frameworks such as DITA

- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as healthcare, finance, or engineering where documentation compliance is essential

## Why Join Us?

- Flexible working arrangements including hybrid and remote options to support a healthy work-life balance

- A collaborative, inclusive team culture that values expertise, continuous learning, and professional growth

- Access to ongoing training, professional development programmes, and support for further education or industry certifications

- Meaningful work that directly contributes to product quality, customer experience, and organisational knowledge

- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits reviewed annually in line with performance

## Job Details

- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift

- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Objective
	To be a key part of the Seafarers Centre teams in North Tasmania with primary responsibility of setting up a sustainable centre and team in Devonport and providing administrative support to ensure the smooth running of the Mission to Seafarers in Bell Bay and Burnie. 

Level of Responsibility	The incumbent reports directly to the Regional Director of Mission to Seafarers Australia (VIC based) while maintaining a close working relationship with the committee members of Tasmania and takes responsibility for the recruitment, training and in Devonport rostering of volunteers.

The day to day operations of the Devonport centre including financial. 

Conditions:	Required to maintain Safe Church Communities endorsement, including a Working with Vulnerable People card.  Drivers Licence 


This role would suit someone who is passionate about helping seafarers and volunteers, who is flexible, well organised and innovative. 


Knowledge / convictions
The candidate should have excellent communication and interpersonal skills and be confident with technology, particularly with a fluent working knowledge of Microsoft Office software, accounting software, and basic web skills to update webpages and manage social media platforms. 
Essential Skills and experiences
•	Office administration experience 
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
•	Proficient in the use of MS Office products and accounting software (incl xero)
•	Experience or demonstrated capacity to coordinate volunteers 
Desirable Skills and experiences
•	Experience of minute taking and preparation of financial reports
•	Website management and social media skills 
•	An understanding of the aims and objectives of the Mission to Seafarers
•	Marketing and Public Relations skills 
•	Fundraising experience 
Duties and Responsibilities
1.	Administrative support 
a.	Compiling agenda and management committee meeting minutes 
b.	Completion and collation of Australian Border Force (ABF) documentation
c.	Maintaining annual registration documentation including charities registration, permits, essential contacts lists
d.	Monitor and acknowledge incoming donations (financial and in-kind) and relevant correspondence 
e.	Providing administrative and practical support to the Chairs, Secretary's, Treasurers, Public Officers, and Ships Visitor Officer.
f.	Manage the supply of Sim Cards and Top-ups for seafarers
g.	Arrange Foreign Currency exchange and reporting
h.	Assisting the Regional Director when requested

2.	Communications and Marketing 
a.	Monitor incoming communications and direct/distribute accordingly 
b.	Coordinate internal communications for the day to day running of the centre i.e roster of volunteers, bus pickups, liaison with shipping agents, TasPorts for Devonport
c.	Act as a key liaison between the MtS and external bodies such as the Anglican Diocese of Tasmania, parish churches, Tas Ports and other relevant bodies
d.	Management of the website and social media platforms 
e.	Coordinating the creation and distribution of creative marketing content to raise the profile of the Mission to Seafarers state-wide 
3.	Volunteer management 
a.	Working with the committees to recruit and train volunteers 
b.	Maintain volunteer contact details and roster for Devonport
c.	Coordinating volunteer permits and licencing including (but not limited to) Working with Vulnerable People card, First Aid training, Ship and Port access training and other relevant training as per the Australian council obligations.
4.	Attendance:
a.	MtS Conferences interstate
b.	Committee meetings in person or via teleconference
c.	Devonport centre as requested by seafarers.
 
The position is currently funded for 3 days per week - days and hours to be negotiated. 
Training across many areas can be completed on the job.
The role would suit someone with at least 6 years work experience and/ or is returning to work.
